method: Freeze these source-based criteria before the subagent receives its task; 1 point complete, 0.5 materially correct but incomplete, 0 absent/wrong. No score for speculation. Related-file facts are separately labeled.
criteria: Application WorkspaceService implements allowlisted filesystem browsing plus registration orchestration; state group *Workspaces, defaults ManagerConfig, roots []domain.FolderRoot.

Identify and explain all 10 named functions/methods: NewWorkspaceService, FolderRoots, root, validFolderPath, Folders, readFolderPage, skipFolderEntries, AddWorkspace, gitRegistrationError, selectedPath. Anonymous deferred closure is distinct, not a second named method.

Canonicalize configured paths, verify os.OpenRoot access then close; IDs lowercase SHA256 of canonical root, basename display name and canonical path; errors abort constructor. canonicalWorkspacePath uses Abs/EvalSymlinks in workspaces.go.
FolderRoots returns a defensive slice copy; root does exact ID lookup and otherwise ErrFolderForbidden.
Nonempty, <=4096 bytes, no NUL, filepath.IsLocal; '.' is allowed, not a general ban on all internal '..' segments or all symlinks.
Folders accepts context, root ID, relative path, offset and returns FolderPage/error; reject offsets <0 or >100000 and invalid path before lookup.
Folders opens an os.Root, then root-relative file handle, closes both with defers. Open failures mapped to ErrFolderForbidden. Root confinement includes symlink components.
Page path cleaned and slash-normalized; initializes nonnil items; skip offset raw entries and ReadDir(100) in native order, not 100 visible folders.
Returns directories except .git; regular files excluded, symlink entries not followed/listed as directories. Other dot-directories are not universally hidden.
Only len(raw entries)==100 sets next_offset=offset+100; an empty visible page can still have a next page, exact multiple can require an extra empty page.
Skips entries with min(offset,100), checks cancellation between chunks, EOF is normal, other read errors become ErrFolderForbidden; no unbounded allocation.
ReadDir EOF tolerated, non-EOF error sanitized, final page returns ctx.Err (may include constructed items and cancellation). This is not a directory snapshot/stable cursor.
selectedPath checks relative folder plus name <=200 bytes/no NUL, allowed root lookup. Raw name length tested before TrimSpace.

Join root and requested path, EvalSymlinks, filepath.Rel and IsLocal reject escapes; failures sanitized. This path check is distinct from os.Root used in browsing, not a proof against every filesystem race.
AddWorkspace calls source.Open with default Options before group.Add. Dependency requires exact working-tree root; no git init/clone/fetch is performed.
Copy defaults and override RepositoryPath and trimmed RepositoryName; invoke group.Add, propagate error; preserve other manager settings.
Return manager.Repository plus AlreadyAdded=reused; gitRegistrationError preserves context cancellation/deadline, otherwise ErrNotGitRepository (doesn't expose raw git error).
workspace.add span; execution.started; deferred completion or telemetry.Fail(workspace_registration_failed) based on named error; span.End. Direct source/name not emitted as trace attributes here.
No direct SQL/LLM/index parsing in this file. Workspace persistence/tracker behavior delegated to group.Add; registration succeeds before background indexing completes.

Workspaces.Add locks, handles closed, duplicate path idempotently, enforces32, requires WorkspaceStore, creates manager and persists before appending/starting; first manager becomes default; failed persistence closes it.

persistAddedWorkspace revalidates actual Git root and delegates durable registration with operator workspace.add execution; avoid claiming target file itself owns transaction or persistence internals.

managedExplorerServer constructs service and passes as WorkspaceManagement; HTTP roots/folders/add call it through interface (static call resolution may not prove concrete target); domain FolderRoot,FolderPage,AddWorkspaceRequest,AddedWorkspace shapes.

Related transport: authenticated root/folder/add endpoints; foreign-origin registration rejected; add 201 new/200 duplicate, folder forbidden403, nonGit422,limit409; not logic directly owned by target.

Existing tests cover escapes/symlink/missing/nonGit(no initialization),105dir pagination/.git hiding,bad offset/unknown root/cancellation,unconfigured manager persistence. If unavailable from API, state unavailable rather than claim executed tests.
unscored_risk_notes: Constructor doesn't deduplicate roots or enforce max configured count itself.
Registration selectedPath is string-based; don't claim all TOCTOU races eliminated. persistAddedWorkspace only compares actual root strings.
Filesystem offsets are O(offset) per browse, no sorting or stable directory snapshot.
No tests are executed in the blind retrieval experiment; existence and execution must be distinguished.
